observations: OWNER-delegated second FTMO-gap candidate (successor to QM-RESEARCH-2026-0002 / QM5_41475 H-CW). The deterministic universe map of the farm's exercised universe shows the high-density FTMO-fit class at 128 pairs (0.86% of 14,939), zero FTMO incumbents in every FX cell, and session-specified FX intraday/scalp mean-reversion coverage of 8 pairs (also 0 FTMO incumbents): the FTMO book has no high-density, short-holding, low-swap FX sleeve. FX intraday mean reversion in the liquid London/New York windows is the canonical density engine for that cell. No offline statistical instrument was used for this candidate; the map is a deterministic projector and the candidate is mechanized directly from the structural cause.
proposed_mechanism: Session-flat FX mean reversion: during the London (07-11 UTC) and New York (12-16 UTC) windows, major FX pairs exhibit short-horizon overextension-reversion - a run of consecutive same-direction M15 closes or an EMA stretch beyond k x ATR is resolved by a close back through a short EMA. Entering on the reclaim, stopping beyond the stretch extreme, targeting a fixed 1.0-1.5R, time-stopping within 8-16 bars and flattening before each session close yields positive out-of-sample expectancy with zero overnight exposure (swap ~ 0).
